reason: The patch adds Group.removeMember and addMembers in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js. Each one chains only .then() onto Discourse.ajax, and neither the model nor the controller actions in admin-group.js.es6 attach a catch or rejection handler. Discourse.ajax (discourse/mixins/ajax.js:51-67) only rejects on error and shows no message of its own, so a 422 or 500 response fails silently.
